table.ruleA: Add each cycle's row of the uptake table to each segment; holding volume not enforced
table.ruleB: Add each cycle's row of the charge table to each crucible; working volume not enforced

table.ruleA: Sequential, segments 1 to 6; if sap > holding volume, the excess goes to n+1 (already there when n+1 is handled) and the segment is set to its holding volume; excess from 6 goes to the loss tally; equal means nothing happens
table.ruleB: Sequential, crucibles 1 to 6; if melt > working volume, the excess goes to n+1 (already there when n+1 is handled) and the crucible is set to its working volume; excess from 6 goes to slag; equal means nothing happens

table.ruleA: Read after step 2; QUIET and sap >= upper mark becomes SINK-ACTIVE; SINK-ACTIVE and sap <= lower mark becomes QUIET; otherwise no change; at most one change per cycle; log (cycle, segment, before, after)
table.ruleB: Read after step 2; BASE and melt >= upper mark becomes SUPERHEATED; SUPERHEATED and melt <= lower mark becomes BASE; otherwise no change; at most one change per cycle; log (cycle, crucible, before, after)

table.ruleA: Simultaneous; amount from sap at the start of the step and the post-step-3 state: QUIET floor(sap/4), SINK-ACTIVE floor(sap/2); every segment drops by its amount; QUIET amount goes to the loss tally; SINK-ACTIVE amount goes to n-1; segment 1's SINK-ACTIVE amount goes to the loss tally; no capacity check
table.ruleB: Simultaneous; amount from melt at the start of the step and the post-step-3 state: BASE floor(melt/4), SUPERHEATED floor(melt/2); every crucible drops by its amount; BASE amount goes to slag; SUPERHEATED amount goes to n-1; crucible 1's SUPERHEATED amount goes to slag; no capacity check

table.ruleA: If the total is strictly greater than 38, all six segments become floor(sap/2), rounded DOWN; the removed sap (ceil(sap/2)) goes to the loss tally; log the cycle; a total of 38 or less does nothing
table.ruleB: If the total is strictly greater than 38, all six crucibles become ceil(melt/2), rounded UP; the removed melt (floor(melt/2)) goes to slag; log the cycle; a total of 38 or less does nothing
table.difference: The rounding of the kept amount when halving fires. A keeps half rounded down, so an odd amount loses its extra unit. B keeps half rounded up, so the odd unit stays in the crucible. The trigger (strictly greater than 38), the scope (all six) and the routing of the removed amount (to the tally) are the same.

table.ruleA: (a) end sap 1-6, (b) end states, (c) state changes in order, (d) leaf-drop cycles or 'none', (e) loss tally, (f) balance check
table.ruleB: (a) end melt 1-6, (b) end states, (c) state changes, (d) emergency tap cycles, (e) slag total, (f) balance check
